lines.text: A blue whale's heart is the size of a bumper car.
And that's not even the weird part.
One preserved blue whale heart weighs about one hundred and eighty kilograms. As much as two grown adults.
lines.caption: One preserved blue whale heart weighs about 180 kilograms. As much as two grown adults.

lines.text: It's the biggest heart of any animal we know, inside the biggest animal that has ever lived.
At the surface, it pounds at more than thirty beats a minute.
And the weird part? On a deep dive, it slows down to just two beats. Per. Minute.
